135 --- Page 7 --- DIPBLOKMUNG MAKKRE chim.
Salsao uamang na'tok makkal dokna ku'mongaha Re'chakatnasion, " Makkala baosa ripeng ?" ine makkre dipbloko singaha.
Makkalde angon badita !
ine dipblok aganchakaha Indaken uamang ripengsa kok ole chibimaona re'angaha Chibimaona sokna skangan dipblok ripengtang mak- kreko boltong.
sote, rajolchina ge'etaha.
Makkreba boltong sote ra'jolangaha.
Mangsonga chibimaona sokoa uamang wari tu'a, na'tok bang'ako niroroaha.
Wariko man'oa, dipblok tipengtang makkrena aganaha.
“" Anga chiningchi nap- angna, na'ara ianon dongsoe angni chiningoni nadoba- on, ia boltongchi angni janggilko ka'sne doksobo.
Indine dgane, dipblok chiningchi napangaha.
Dipblokni nadobaanti makkre janggilo doksobebeaha, Unon dipblokoni gipok gipok dake bisi  ongkatenba wari gimikan gape, na'tokrang uko ringoa, bang'en siaha.
Unon makkremung dipblok ua na'tokrangko rim'e chimongoa, koksa ong'pile man'aha.
Attamoa uamang na'tokrangko suale ra'enba  nok- tangtangchi re'angpilaha.
Ramajoljol makkrede ripeng- rc'angengachim.

Makkal doke man'gimin na'tokrangko bon'manoa, inakkre an'tang jikgipana aganaha, " Hai, an'chingba da'alde chibimachi na'tok makkal dokna " --- Page 8 --- A'CHIK GOLPORANG BAK I " Makkalde baosa ?" ine jikgipa singaha.
Makkalde angon badita!
na'asa na'tok olbana kok balko ole re'aibo ine segipa aganaha.
Makkre kotip kadareke, atte ripee, sosoiget soiget, mese ki'me gol'riket ine ku'smike jikko skang wate chibinachi re'angaha Chibimaona sokangna skangan makkre ramaoniko boltong sote ra'angaha.

Chibimaona sokangoa, wari tu'kala, na'tok bang'- kalako niroroaha Chi kosakchi am'doange tu'gipa wariko nikahaoa, makkre jikgipana aganaha, “ Anga chiningchi napanggen ; na ara angni chiningoni nado- baantin angko doksobo.
Angoni gipok gipok dake ongkatjaskal na'ara doksoaibone.
Indine jikgipana agane an'tangde chiningchi napangbebeaha.
Segipani agana gita jikgipa segipani chiningoni nadobaantin bil kakket kakket boltongchi doksoaha.
Adita doksoon segipani sko brete taning ong'katc chio gipok gipok nikpilaha.
Unosa jikgipa dokako dontongaha.
Danang !
segipade sko brete, sre ong'kate sienba balbopilengaha !
A'gaona gakatbaboaha, mainasa chion jroe rocha- enga ?
ine jikgipa chrike okamataha.
Pilnipil okamoba re'bajanasa, maiban ong'ahama ine chanchie, jikgip.
jroange a'gaona saldobaoa.
segipani sko brete, sre ong'kate siakosa nikaiaha.
Jikgipa duk ong'bee, grape grape, na'tok ole ra'na ra'bagipa kok balo segipani manggisikosa olangskae noktangona re'angpilaha.
Ma'sichenggija gipinni kamko ja'rikpaania antargna gimaanikosan ra'baa.
--- Page 9 --- MONGMAMUNG CHIBRIM Changsao mongma jiksesa badiaba burung dam- sako re'angengachim.
Unon uamang chibrim mangsani an'tangni jikgipani manggisiko gope galna ine saksan de'tome ra angcngako nikaha.
Mongma bipa chibrinko chonnike aganaha.
Nio nikrakgija, rim'o inan'rakgij.
mangmangba jiktangko gope galna ra'angnade am- paakonke !
Amjaoba jiktangko sana nisipakugen inesa dak- paenga na'd, ine chibrim aganchakaha, Haida, na'ade anggitamangba daknan amenga anjacnga !
Indinako knae mongma aganaha.
Angko chonnika- ma ?
Angni jikgipa gita mangbongani manggisiko rang- san de'tome gope galbo ine inoba anga mangcnchim !
Chibrimni chonnikako man'e mongmade kao nangan gape, chibrimna an'tangko mesokna inc jikgipako waganchi su'e siataha.
Unon chibrim gita gope galpana ine an'tangni janggil kosakona gatna de'dooa amjaha.
De'tomna jotton ka'tailai nioibd amjaha ine nikoa, ua manggisini sambao sJntit gapc dongaiaha.
Untalsa monginara, Angnade chibrinan bilakhat.
ine chibrinna keuna a bachengihana.
ginnins!
da'ona kingking mongm.at ng jcko cha'oha, rin dongcngnaha donga inc kenchake, dokchichi: gochichic galchengesa chd'a inc A'chikrang agand.
Biltangko nichenggija gaot  de' na narigja.
--- Page 10 --- ABISA A-BA TUA Walsao Noremung Chire abisa mina a'ba tuenga- chim.
Uamang mikrake dongna manna gita gongminako doke roengachim.
Gong gegong ang'ke grong, gegong, Bil-ik kambe gongritong, gegong, Den'na dako tapritgong, gegong.
Mia Misi rimitak, gegong, Ang'ke ja'si ja'ritak, gegong.
Matcha iako knaenba uamangni turam borang kokkimao dimrim dimrim dake chrokeaha.
ku'nengana gongminako dokgija dontongode, matchara uamang abisako chike cha'na ine borang jang'kiko rikkak rikkak ine maldoangaiachim.
Una gongminako dokattaiodc, a'china ong'onen matcha chroktaiachim.
Uni gimin uamang abisa bodol bodol gongmina doke on'chaen, neng'amung kenamung amchakang piljaengahachim.

Abitang Nore nogipana aganaha, An'ching  matcha- oni jokna maiba chol mingsasikkode dakna nanggen Indine nogipa Chire gongmina doke on'mitingo abi- tang noksik nokbak am'e nioara akkaru mina rongsako nikenba, uko chu'dapo gope, ua minkujana kingking gongminakon bodol bodol doke on'angkuaha.
Akkaru minaha ine nikahaoara nokdechol gita a'achi uko galonatenba, rang'san, Aiao angdede!
nono, aiao angsade !
abi a'achina ga'akangjokke inc chrika dak tokaha.
Maisa nono chaboda !
Haida !
abi re'boda !
ine grapa skima dakaha.
